description: This Java class 'ComponentMetaDataDecorator' is a web span decorator that adds component-specific tags to an OpenTracing span during HTTP request processing, rerouting, response handling, and failure scenarios within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: ComponentMetaDataDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds specific tags to tracing spans for HTTP requests in the Hono project.

methods.name: ComponentMetaDataDecorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with optional custom tags.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Adds HTTP method, URL, and custom tags to the span when a request starts.

methods.name: onReroute
methods.description: Logs reroute event with request method and URL.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code on the span when a response is sent.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description: Logs error details to the span when request processing fails.
